pages.setting: Cozy craft corner at the child's home beside the evening footpath
pages.mainAction: The child lights a paper moon lantern while the companion's tongue misses it, presses the delivery-cart button, and sends the lantern rolling away.
pages.heroObject: paper moon lantern on a puppy-sized night delivery cart
pages.lighting: Warm indoor lamplight meeting cool early-evening light at the doorway

pages.setting: Hedge-lined pedestrian garden path after sunset
pages.mainAction: The cart salutes one hedge after another until the child catches it and presses the brake while the companion fixes a new label to the route.
pages.heroObject: braked night delivery cart carrying the moon lantern
pages.lighting: Soft garden lamps and fading blue evening light

pages.setting: Closing market arcade beside an open bakery window
pages.mainAction: The child turns the cart handle toward the kindergarten as the bakery window opens, while the companion labels a bread roll and the cart lunges after it.
pages.heroObject: bread roll pulling the lantern cart off route
pages.lighting: Warm bakery-window glow against the darkening market arcade

pages.setting: Round fountain crossing between the bakery and the distant kindergarten gate
pages.mainAction: The child arranges three wet labels into a closed ring inside the cart, which circles the fountain and returns with the bread roll resting on the companion's head.
pages.heroObject: closed ring of wet route labels inside the circling cart
pages.lighting: Fountain reflections, warm bakery spill, and a small pool of light at the distant gate
continuityAnchors: three wet labels joined into a closed ring
same bread roll from the bakery

pages.setting: Flat stone beside the fountain on the route to the kindergarten
pages.mainAction: The child's hands open the label ring into a path and place a blank label at its end while the companion watches both the route behind and the way forward.
pages.heroObject: opened route-label path ending in one blank label
pages.lighting: Rippling fountain light across the stone and labels
continuityAnchors: same wet route labels now opened into a path
same night delivery cart waiting beside the stone

pages.setting: Safe pedestrian path rising toward the closed kindergarten gate
pages.mainAction: The child threads the ordered labels into the cart, holds the blank final label, and leads the lantern up the last unmapped stretch toward the gate.
pages.heroObject: ordered label ribbon guiding the moon-lantern cart
pages.lighting: Quiet moonlight with the lantern casting a warm moving pool along the path
continuityAnchors: blank label remains in the child's hand

pages.setting: New kindergarten courtyard just before the gate closes for the night
pages.mainAction: The child lifts and hangs the moon lantern above the courtyard path, then draws a moon on the blank label as the guard and companion watch.
pages.heroObject: newly hung paper moon lantern and completed terminal label
pages.lighting: The paper lantern switches on against a calm moonlit courtyard
continuityAnchors: same paper moon lantern now hanging above the path
same night delivery cart stopped at the gate
ordered label ribbon ends with the completed moon label

pages.setting: Child's bedroom at night with the kindergarten visible beyond the rooftops
pages.mainAction: The child settles in bed while the companion curls on the windowsill and closes one eye, then the other, beneath the distant blink of the moon lantern.
pages.heroObject: distant paper moon lantern glowing in the kindergarten courtyard
pages.lighting: Dim bedside glow, cool moonlight, and one distant warm lantern beyond the window
continuityAnchors: same paper moon lantern now visible across the rooftops
